[[File:ZirtransAnchor-Journal5.jpg|thumb|right|The disappearance of the space station known as Zirtran's Anchor took on the air of a folk tale.]]
'''The Vanishing''' was the colloquial name for the disappearance of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]] sometime during the reign of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The disappearance occurred after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent a representative to the space station to monitor commerce there, angering the free-trading [[Geelan]] who owned the establishment. When the Geelan named [[Whisk the Elder]] prophesied that the station would befall a catastrophe if the Empire did not ease its hand there, Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Vence Tabok]] ignored him.<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>

Only days later, Whisk's prophesy came true: visitors to the [[Besberra system/Legends|Besberra system]], where the station had previously been located, found no trace of it or its inhabitants. Rumors spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that the station had fallen victim to an attack&mdash;either from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], or [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], or the Empire. Another story held that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had an active investigation into the station's whereabouts. Other tales ascribed the station's disappearance to the bad luck of the [[Zirtran brothers (disambiguation)|Zirtran brothers]], the station's former owners, finally catching up to the Geelan. Yet another claimed that the Geelan had stolen an artifact from an entity that dwelled in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], and that the entity had taken its revenge. One final rumor claimed that the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of the barge at the heart of Zirtran's Anchor had finally started working again, taking the station with it.<ref name="ZA" /> The event took on the air of a folk tale, referred to mysteriously as "the Vanishing".<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>

The station was later found in a completely different location, light-years away in the [[Phosphura Belt Nebula/Legends|Phosphura Belt Nebula]]. All the inhabitants were gone - at least, all the organic life, down to the last microbe. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that remained could offer no explanation nor knowledge of what had happened. A new set of Geelan resumed control of the station and worked to restore its status as a lively trading hub. Some relatives of the missing proprietors came to the station to take over their lost family members' businesses.<ref name="ZA" />
